cor:exactreturn.title: Exact return
cor:exactreturn.body: If $\sigma_n=\sigma_0$, then $\Omega_n=\tau^{\otimes n}$ and the final output--memory mutual information is zero. No closed device can purify maximally mixed inputs while returning its memory exactly, for any initial memory state.

prop:capable.title: Product initializer
prop:capable.body: For every strict partial swap and $M\ge2$, there is a product state $\omega\in V_{e_M}$ with $F(\omega,p^{\otimes M})=0$. Hence $S_{e_M}(n)\to0$ and $e_M/S_{e_M}(n)\to+\infty$.

prop:entropy-density.title: Different entropy densities
prop:entropy-density.body: For any finite-dimensional one-site states $a,b$ with $S(a)\ne S(b)$, any fixed finite memory dimension $D$, and any initial memory state independent of $a^{\otimes n}$, the joint trace error from $b^{\otimes n}$ tends to one as $n\to\infty$. The conclusion even allows an arbitrary global unitary at each horizon.
